title: Russian Lamb Pilaf
description: A traditional Russian dish made with lamb, pilaf, and spices, perfect for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set it aside.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the thyme, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the skillet and cover with a lid.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook at 180°C (350°F) for 1.5-2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
